tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lag mchod bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lag mchod byed par 'dod pas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga nang mchod me tog phud phor zan ḍā ma ru rnams nges par tshogs par byas pas/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ lag pa g.yon pa/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lag mthil du pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa/ lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan/ sor mo'i tshigs dbus ma rnams dang*/ sen mo rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la pad zla'i gdan re re/ de nas nang mchod nas g.yas kyi srin lag gis blang ste/ lag mthil dang*/ sor mo'i tshigs dang*/ sen mo rnams gcig tu 'dus pa la thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ oṃ ha/ nas/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar tshar gcig brjod/ lag mthil gyi pad+ma'i lte bar/ oṃ baṃ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo mdun nas g.yon skor gyi 'dab ma lnga la rim pas/ haṃ yoṃ sngon mo= nas/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i ngo bo/ mthe bong la oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'dzub mo la oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ gung mo la oṃ swāhā hūṃ dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /srin lag la oṃ bau ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mthe'u chung la oṃ hūṃ hūṃ ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ sen mo rnams gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngos la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa haṃ ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lag pa'i sa khams sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu khams mā ma ki me khams gos dkar mo/ rlung khams sgrol ma/ nam mkha'i khams pad+ma dra ba can no/ / slar yang de thams cad kyi gnas su nang mchod gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bcu gnyis brjod/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma'i tshigs lag mthil gyi rgyab ngos dang bcas par skad cig tsam gyis 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor grub par gyur pa ni/ gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rim pa bzhi/ lha'i gdan dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du 'khor lo bde mchog / zhes pa nas/ thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'i

bar mkha' nang gi dkyil 'khor bzhin bskyed/ mdun gyi mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs/ thog mar me tog nas g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul bar mos te/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ 'khor rnams la sngags phreng bzhin tshar gcig brjod nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ zhes lag mthil du spungs/ yang blangs te/ oṃ oṃ ha= nas/ phaṭa phaṭa/ kyi bar brjod cing*/ so so'i gnas su reg la/ lag mthil du spungs/ zan yang de bzhin du 'bul ba las/ puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ gi tshab tu/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin chang la sogs pa khu ba'i rdzas yod na'ang cho ga de khas 'bul/ de nas/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ / zhes pa nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag rgya rnams lag pa g.yas pas byed/ nang mchod 'bul tshul/ me tog dang zan 'bul ba dang 'dra/ a nu rā ga na'i sngags kyis gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ lag pa g.yas kyis ḍā ma ru bkrol zhing*/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag la dngos grub mtha' dag stsal du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs brjod/ lag mthil gyi rdzas rnams snod gcig tu spungs la/ lag pa la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams phan tshun du mnyes shing*/ oṃ a kā ro sogs brjod pas/ lha rnams rang gnas su thim par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shud+dho sogs la 'khyud rgya/ spyi bo'i thad du byed/ tshogs 'khor dang mdun bskyed sogs byed na'ang skabs 'di nas 'jug cing*/ lag mchod kho na byed na/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ zhes pa nas/ bkra shis kyi bar rjes chog ltar bya'o/ /lag mchod kyi ngag 'don mdor bsdus pa 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dag bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lag mchod bzhugs/
